why: Beaches are one of the spawn types runners reset to find. Beaches have buried treasure (iron and food early, found with F3 without the map), and the ocean gives access to magma ravines with obsidian and lava for a quick portal. Trees give wood for tools.
trap: Reset because there is no village or ruined portal in sight.

techniques.description: Keep beach spawns with wood and a shipwreck/buried treasure.
